title: Percy Jackson — visual style references
note: Private design reference. Every image belongs to its credited owner; image_url and page_url record where each was found.

images.title: Taiwan Chinese edition, The Lightning Thief (神火之賊)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson: The Lightning Thief (Taiwan Chinese edition)
images.what_it_shows: A boy in green tumbles back with a sword before a skyscraper and crashing waves under a lightning-streaked sky.
images.style_notes: Painterly storm scene in violet-grey and cream; moody and melodramatic, small figure under huge waves.

images.title: Lightning Thief (Rocco)
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief, US Disney-Hyperion paperback
images.what_it_shows: Percy seen from behind in orange shirt standing on a sea-green wave-wrapped trident-like shape with storm skyline and lightning.
images.style_notes: Dark painterly digital/oil look, backlit figure, murky teal and amber palette; small figure against huge symbolic shapes; moody and mythic.

images.title: Sea of Monsters (Rocco)
images.source_work: The Sea of Monsters, US Hyperion
images.what_it_shows: Two tiny silhouettes run across a rope bridge beneath a giant glowing Cyclops eye over a ship.
images.style_notes: Orange-red firelit painterly palette, tiny figures dwarfed by scale; silhouette storytelling.

images.title: Titan's Curse (Rocco)
images.source_work: The Titan's Curse, US Hyperion
images.what_it_shows: A winged horse-like gargoyle statue on a skyscraper ledge over a blue misty city with a dark rider silhouette.
images.style_notes: Cool blue-grey painterly atmosphere, cityscape haze, figure reduced to silhouette.

images.title: Brazil Intrínseca Lightning Thief
images.source_work: O Ladrão de Raios, Intrínseca
images.what_it_shows: Percy in yellow shirt wading into a green sea holding a sword before a lightning-lit skyline.
images.style_notes: Painterly green-gold palette; near the US look, little stylistic difference.

images.title: Battle of the Labyrinth (Rocco)
images.source_work: The Battle of the Labyrinth, US Hyperion
images.what_it_shows: Silhouetted boy with sword before a fiery doorway and labyrinth floor pattern.
images.style_notes: Hot red/orange firelight, strong geometric maze floor, backlit silhouette.

images.title: Last Olympian (Rocco)
images.source_work: The Last Olympian, US Hyperion
images.what_it_shows: Percy with raised sword riding a black winged pegasus past a giant sword-like Empire State Building amid burning New York.
images.style_notes: Moody sepia/green painterly, dynamic diagonal, epic scale.

images.title: Percy Jackson's Greek Gods cover
images.source_work: Percy Jackson's Greek Gods
images.what_it_shows: Percy silhouetted in a glowing archway surrounded by painted gods (Poseidon, Artemis, Athena, Zeus) and a trident.
images.style_notes: Rich painterly collage of gods, warm/cool contrast, Percy small and backlit.

images.title: Percy Jackson's Greek Heroes, textless cover art (John Rocco)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson's Greek Heroes (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Heroes in mythic poses on either side of a winged horse flying toward a sailing ship through a fiery sunset sky; Percy and Annabeth are not depicted.
images.style_notes: Rich painterly digital illustration with orange-gold sunset glow and lavender shadows; heroic classical proportions, cinematic composition.

images.title: Annabeth standing beside Mr. D playing cards
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: Illustrated Edition (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Blonde ponytailed Annabeth in an orange camp tee glares with arms folded beside a rumpled Dionysus holding cards at a table.
images.style_notes: Loose watercolour vignette with blue-grey wash edge; realistic, slightly gritty child proportions and a wary mood.

images.title: Annabeth tending Percy in the infirmary
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: Illustrated Edition (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth, seen from behind in an orange tee with a ponytail, holds a cup with a straw to Percy as he sits propped in an infirmary bed.
images.style_notes: Watercolour-style with fine linework and teal/slate shadows over bright white; naturalistic proportions and a quiet, tender mood.

images.title: Grover, Percy and Annabeth standing together in camp shirts
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: Illustrated Edition (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: The three questers outdoors in orange camp tees: Grover in a green cap, Percy in the middle and ponytailed Annabeth on the right.
images.style_notes: Soft watercolour vignette, earthy ochre and sky-blue; realistic proportions, tween-age casual poses.

images.title: Trio wearing laurel wreaths
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: Illustrated Edition (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Three smiling kids with arms around each other wear laurel wreaths and yellow-orange shirts, Annabeth at left.
images.style_notes: Watercolour with soft blue-grey vignette; warm yellow-orange tones, affectionate and celebratory.

images.title: Illustrated Edition cover
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: The Illustrated Edition
images.what_it_shows: Percy with sword stands in surf as a minotaur, Medusa, lion and skeleton warriors surge from a stormy sunset sky over NYC.
images.style_notes: Colourful watercolour-like painted illustration, saturated blue/orange, comic-adventure monsters, child-friendly but dramatic.

images.title: Annabeth Chase character portrait (Antonio Caparo)
images.source_work: The Demigod Files (character portraits, Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth tipping a navy Yankees cap, ponytail over her shoulder, smiling in an orange Camp Half-Blood shirt on a swirling pink-peach ground.
images.style_notes: Digital painting, soft rendering, warm peach and rose palette; slightly exaggerated cartoony proportions, friendly smirk, reads younger than the cover Annabeths.

images.title: Percy Jackson character portrait (Antonio Caparo)
images.source_work: The Demigod Files (character portraits, Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: Percy in an orange Camp Half-Blood shirt holding a bronze sword point-up, smiling slightly against a mottled green-gold backdrop.
images.style_notes: Digital painting with painterly texture and mild caricature; warm orange against teal-green, boyish round face, dark messy hair.

images.title: Graphic novel Lightning Thief cover
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: The Graphic Novel
images.what_it_shows: Percy in orange shirt and jeans wields glowing bronze sword Riptide in rushing water.
images.style_notes: Comic realism, inked figures with digital painted colour, dynamic pose, teal-grey water and orange accent.

images.title: Annabeth close-up panel, Percy Jackson graphic novel
images.artist: Attila Futaki (art), Robert Venditti (adaptation); colourist not confirmed
images.source_work: Percy Jackson graphic novel series (Disney-Hyperion; volume not confirmed)
images.what_it_shows: Close crop of a blonde Annabeth in a blue jacket, holding papers and mid-speech, with speech balloons cut off at the right edge.
images.style_notes: Realistic, ink-and-wash comic colouring in muted olive and violet; naturalistic proportions, long loose blonde hair, serious adult-leaning face.

images.title: Sea of Monsters GN page: Annabeth sleeping in sunlight, then Percy and Clarisse beside her
images.artist: Attila Futaki (art), José Villarrubia (colour), Robert Venditti (adaptation)
images.source_work: The Sea of Monsters: The Graphic Novel
images.what_it_shows: Large close-ups of Annabeth unconscious with golden light on her hair, with lower panels of Percy, Clarisse and campers around her.
images.style_notes: Saturated warm yellows and oranges, soft glowing highlights on loose wavy blond hair; semi-realistic, cinematic cropping.

images.title: Sea of Monsters GN page: Annabeth at the helm, Percy tied to the mast before the Sirens
images.artist: Attila Futaki (art), José Villarrubia (colour), Robert Venditti (adaptation)
images.source_work: The Sea of Monsters: The Graphic Novel
images.what_it_shows: A full interior page: Annabeth steers the ship at night in an orange Camp Half-Blood tee while Percy argues to be tied up so he can hear the Sirens.
images.style_notes: Painterly comic colouring with warm lamplight against deep indigo night; semi-realistic proportions, long straight pale-blond Annabeth with a stern face; scanned print page.

images.title: Graphic novel Last Olympian cover
images.source_work: The Last Olympian: The Graphic Novel
images.what_it_shows: Close-up of Percy's green eyes behind a sword blade in which Annabeth's reflection can be seen.
images.style_notes: Anime-influenced clean line comic style, stylised face, rain-blue palette, intimate.

images.title: Original UK Last Olympian
images.source_work: The Last Olympian, UK Puffin original
images.what_it_shows: Armoured Kronos-like warrior looms over a small red-clad figure in a glowing blue city; winged helmet above.
images.style_notes: Glowing blue/magenta digital, heavy vignette, bold gold title; small hero vs huge menace.

images.title: Puffin 2013 Battle of the Labyrinth
images.source_work: The Battle of the Labyrinth, UK Puffin
images.what_it_shows: Percy with a bronze sword and shield amid flames before the Golden Gate Bridge.
images.style_notes: Hot orange fire palette, realistic digital composite.

images.title: Puffin 2013 Lightning Thief
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief, UK Puffin redesign
images.what_it_shows: Percy in orange shirt hurls a spear/sword under a blue lightning-filled sky with New York skyline.
images.style_notes: Photographic-digital realistic figure, electric blue storm palette, genre-thriller feel; real-looking teenager.

images.title: Puffin 2013 Titan's Curse
images.source_work: The Titan's Curse, UK Puffin
images.what_it_shows: Percy on a black pegasus in stormy purple sky with Golden Gate Bridge.
images.style_notes: Dusky purple-blue dramatic digital composite.

images.title: Le Voleur de foudre, French (Albin Michel) collector edition
images.source_work: Percy Jackson et les Olympiens: Le Voleur de foudre (Albin Michel, collector)
images.what_it_shows: Percy seen from behind with a sword before an ornate columned frame, thrones and creatures of Olympus in pastel colours.
images.style_notes: Decorative, Art-Nouveau-like gold-framed illustration in soft pastels; storybook feel, tiny figure.

images.title: Il ladro di fulmini, new Italian (Mondadori Oscar) cover
images.artist: Victo Ngai (attributed: same art as the US redesign)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson e gli dei dell'Olimpo: Il ladro di fulmini (Mondadori)
images.what_it_shows: A gold trident-sword, winged helmet and lightning bolt before a pale sun disc and cloud swirls on a teal ground; no characters.
images.style_notes: Decorative emblem illustration in teal, gold and cream with ornamental clouds; modern, heraldic.

images.title: 2022 redesign Titan's Curse
images.artist: Victo Ngai (attributed: matches her redesigned series packaging)
images.source_work: The Titan's Curse, new US cover
images.what_it_shows: Black winged Pegasus-like horse before a huge pale moon above a crouching small figure on a peak.
images.style_notes: Flat-ish decorative illustration, magenta-to-orange gradient, patterned wings and clouds; graphic, art-print feel. Artist unverified.

images.title: The Lightning Thief, US 2022-23 paperback redesign cover
images.artist: Victo Ngai (attributed: matches her redesigned series packaging)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians 1: The Lightning Thief (Disney-Hyperion, series redesign)
images.what_it_shows: A trident-topped sword, a lightning bolt and a winged helmet on a pale gold-teal ground; no characters shown.
images.style_notes: Flat-ish emblematic vector illustration in teal and gold, symmetrical and iconographic; cover illustrator not confirmed in sources found.

images.title: The Chalice of the Gods, US cover
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians: The Chalice of the Gods (Disney-Hyperion)
images.what_it_shows: A coiled sea-green serpent rises from a golden cup flanked by chickens on a deep navy ground; no human characters are visible.
images.style_notes: Ornamental, near-symmetrical illustration in jade, gold and midnight blue with fine line detail echoing Greek vase painting; elegant and decorative.

images.title: Chalice of the Gods crop
images.source_work: The Chalice of the Gods cover detail (Omelete article)
images.what_it_shows: Cropped banner of a golden Greek kylix with black-figure athletes, fish and swirling water.
images.style_notes: Greek vase-painting motifs rendered in flat decorative digital art on teal; no Percy or Annabeth.

images.title: Wrath of the Triple Goddess
images.source_work: Wrath of the Triple Goddess
images.what_it_shows: Hecate shown as three heads (horse, lion, dog) holding torches above a mansion.
images.style_notes: Flat ornamental graphic style, golds and greens on black-to-orange flames, no Percy or Annabeth.

images.title: El cáliz de los dioses, Spanish (Salamandra) cover
images.source_work: Percy Jackson y los dioses del Olimpo: El cáliz de los dioses (Salamandra)
images.what_it_shows: Percy in a teal tee with a dagger in a serpent-wrapped golden chalice pose, with blond Annabeth glancing back at left and goat-legged Grover at right.
images.style_notes: Polished semi-manga-influenced digital illustration; golden amber palette, large expressive eyes, slim youthful proportions.

images.title: The Chalice of the Gods, UK Puffin cover
images.source_work: The Chalice of the Gods (Puffin UK)
images.what_it_shows: Percy leaps up holding the chalice overhead amid tangled green snakes and crackling lightning, seen from below against a rainbow burst.
images.style_notes: Vivid digital illustration with neon yellow, purple and rainbow gradients; dynamic low-angle action, Percy small and faceless within the energy.

images.title: El ladrón del rayo, Spanish (Salamandra) 2023 cover
images.source_work: Percy Jackson y los dioses del Olimpo 1: El ladrón del rayo (Salamandra)
images.what_it_shows: Percy with sword and swirling water in front, ponytailed Annabeth throwing her Yankees cap beside him, Grover behind, and Poseidon with trident in a stone doorway.
images.style_notes: Anime-leaning digital art with cool blue storm palette, big luminous eyes and clean cel-like shading; the most Annabeth-forward cover in the set.

images.title: Japanese Holp Shuppan edition vol. 1, 盗まれた雷撃 (The Lightning Thief)
images.source_work: パーシー・ジャクソンとオリンポスの神々 1 盗まれた雷撃 (Holp Shuppan)
images.what_it_shows: A small spiky-haired boy with a sword faces a giant monster silhouette in front of city towers inside a gold-ruled frame.
images.style_notes: Flat black-and-grey silhouette graphics with metallic gold title foil; stylised, poster-like, almost woodcut rather than realistic.

images.title: Japanese Holp Shuppan edition vol. 3, タイタンの呪い (The Titan's Curse)
images.source_work: パーシー・ジャクソンとオリンポスの神々 3 タイタンの呪い (Holp Shuppan)
images.what_it_shows: A shield-and-sword boy faces a gold-maned Nemean lion under a full moon on a snowy cliff.
images.style_notes: Graphic flat-colour illustration in midnight navy and gold with a retro-poster feel and a bold decorative frame.

images.title: Japanese Holp edition side-story, パーシー・ジャクソンとオリンポスの神々 外伝 ハデスの剣 (The Demigod Files)
images.source_work: パーシー・ジャクソンとオリンポスの神々 外伝 ハデスの剣 (Holp Shuppan; The Demigod Files)
images.what_it_shows: A black-silhouetted figure with spiky hair raises a huge sword toward a grey crowd below the Japanese title on a slate-blue cover. The wiki labels the file Chinese but the text is Japanese (Holp).
images.style_notes: Stark monochrome silhouette with a single orange accent; flat, graphic, manga-adjacent.

images.title: Alternate poster, trio with shield
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy with Riptide and a bronze shield, Annabeth with dagger at right, Grover at left, in churning sea with a hydra and storm behind.
images.style_notes: Saturated teal and green sea against warm orange city fire, golden metallic title lettering; Annabeth in casual layered top, not armour.

images.title: Key art, trio in the wave
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy in the centre with arms spread inside a spiral wall of water and lightning; Annabeth and Grover flank him with a city skyline behind.
images.style_notes: Teal and white water vortex, dramatic low-angle hero pose, contemporary streetwear costumes.

images.title: Blue stylised Percy poster
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy against a flat blue radial background holding a glowing sword with a shield on his arm.
images.style_notes: Flat bright cyan backdrop with cut-out character, simplified and almost game-box-like; green jacket, golden shield.

images.title: Poster, trio with shield and sword
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy front and centre with glowing sword and round bronze shield, Annabeth and Grover behind in rubble and surf.
images.style_notes: Desaturated grey-blue grading with gold title; gritty action-adventure feel, modern clothes plus a classical shield.

images.title: Theatrical poster
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy seen from behind rising out of stormy water, raising a glowing sword into lightning. Low resolution (260x385).
images.style_notes: Cold teal and black, glossy blockbuster-fantasy lighting, water spray and lightning as the dominant motif; modern hoodie/tee costume.

images.title: Promo, Percy with water trident
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy in a dark hoodie on a night rooftop with a glass-like water trident rising beside him and a city skyline behind.
images.style_notes: Night-city blues and glittering CG water; urban fantasy look with the gods' symbols rendered as water sculpture.

images.title: Still, trio by the pickup
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Grover, Percy and Annabeth standing beside a rusty vehicle in warm light.
images.style_notes: Warm earthy palette and casual layered clothing, a realistic road-movie look.

images.title: Still, Percy Annabeth Grover
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Percy (hooded), Annabeth and Grover standing close, looking worried outdoors in daylight.
images.style_notes: Naturalistic daylight photography, muted blue/brown denim and cotton clothes; grounded road-trip tone. No armour in this still.

images.title: Teaser poster, trident of lightning
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, film, 2010
images.what_it_shows: A glowing blue trident-shaped sword crackling with lightning on black, with the tagline 'Some heroes are made and some are born of the gods'.
images.style_notes: Minimal black field with electric blue emblem; symbolic poster with no characters, useful as logo/icon direction.

images.title: Movie tie-in cover
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief movie tie-in
images.what_it_shows: Photo-style boy raising a lightning bolt, wet shirt, city flooded behind.
images.style_notes: Live-action film photography with composite, desaturated blue; realistic.

images.title: Key art, heroes and icy dragon
images.source_work: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters, film, 2013
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth, Percy holding a sword and Tyson in front of a translucent blue sea monster.
images.style_notes: Icy cyan monochrome with leather jackets and plaits; strong single-hue treatment.

images.title: Theatrical poster, Sea of Monsters
images.source_work: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters, film, 2013
images.what_it_shows: Dark teaser poster of the heroes lined up with the tagline 'In demigods we trust'. Low resolution (256x390).
images.style_notes: Near-black monochrome with gold serif title; moody and darker than the first film.

images.title: Still, Percy and Annabeth on deck
images.source_work: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters, film, 2013
images.what_it_shows: Percy in a dark jacket and Annabeth in a red plaid jacket with a side braid on a ship's deck under bright sky.
images.style_notes: Bright seaside daylight, contemporary clothes; a bright adventure tone.

images.title: Promo, crew aboard the boat
images.source_work: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters, film, 2013
images.what_it_shows: The cast lined up at the rail of a rickety boat in a golden, glowing sea.
images.style_notes: Warm orange sunset grading and wooden-boat set dressing; adventure-ensemble composition.

images.title: S1 key art, glowing sword
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Three young leads lit from below by a blue-white glowing sword hilt on a deep navy background.
images.style_notes: Deep navy with electric-blue under-lighting, simple portrait style; clean and modern.

images.title: S1 teaser, Percy kneeling before the wave
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Percy kneeling on a beach with a sword planted in the sand while a huge parted wave rises behind him.
images.style_notes: Cinematic painterly composition in teal sea and warm gold sand, epic scale; muted, filmic palette.

images.title: Still, Annabeth in armour at camp
images.artist: Disney+ / Disney Branded Television (costume: Tish Monaghan)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth in a gold-crested helm and gold-toned leather and bronze armour at Camp Half-Blood.
images.style_notes: Bright daylight at camp with campers in bronze armour behind; golden leather cuirass and plume read clearly at a distance.

images.title: Promo, Annabeth half-helmet portrait
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth's face split down the middle, one half bare and one half in a glowing bronze Corinthian-style helm.
images.style_notes: Dark background with orange rim light and a hard split composition; an iconic armour-versus-person graphic.

images.title: Still, trio in camp shirts
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Three young demigods in orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirts standing in a birch forest.
images.style_notes: Muted woodland greens and browns with the saturated orange tee as the single accent; ideal camp-look reference.

images.title: Still, Percy and Annabeth in bronze helmets
images.artist: Disney+ / Disney Branded Television (costume: Tish Monaghan)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Percy in a blue-plumed bronze helm and Annabeth in a yellow-crested helm with tarnished bronze breastplates, close together.
images.style_notes: Hand-built, scratched and dented Greek-hoplite armour with warm daylight; believable practical costume rather than gleaming prop metal.

images.title: S2 key art, Sea of Monsters
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 2, 2025
images.what_it_shows: Percy swinging a golden sword with Annabeth and Grover behind while a sea serpent coils through crashing waves.
images.style_notes: Dark teal storm seas with gold sword highlight; more monstrous and adventurous than S1.

images.title: S2 still, trio close-up
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 2, 2025
images.what_it_shows: Close three-shot of Grover, Percy and Annabeth under a stormy grey sky.
images.style_notes: Soft overcast light, earthy browns and olives, naturalistic skin and costume texture.

images.title: S2 poster, trio
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 2, 2025
images.what_it_shows: Percy, Grover and Annabeth in wet jackets, Percy holding a bronze sword, on a pale foggy poster.
images.style_notes: Light cream/grey misted palette (a lighter note than the dark S1 art); weathered denim, cargo and leather layers.

images.title: Illustrated stylised poster
images.artist: Disney+ (illustrated variant; artist not credited on source page)
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Illustrated poster of a hero silhouette on a rocky peak beneath a swirling orange and blue storm vortex with the title.
images.style_notes: Painterly, flat-shaded illustration in royal blue and fire orange with ink-like line work; a graphic non-photographic option.

images.title: S1 Annabeth character poster
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Annabeth with a dagger in a haloed ornamental frame with owl wings and the series title.
images.style_notes: Black and burnished-orange engraving or gilt-icon style, Byzantine/Greek vase-frame ornament; very strong graphic art direction.

images.title: S1 Percy character poster
images.source_work: Percy Jackson and the Olympians, Disney+ season 1, 2023
images.what_it_shows: Percy with Riptide in a sun-disc halo flanked by sea-horse (hippocampi) and a trident motif.
images.style_notes: Same orange-on-black gilded-icon system as the other character posters; plaid shirt and sword set into ornamental relief.

images.title: Broadway production, Percy Annabeth Grover
images.artist: Jeremy Daniel / production (photographer credit by publication; verify)
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical, Longacre Theatre, Broadway 2019
images.what_it_shows: Percy centre with arms thrown up, Annabeth at left and Grover at right in rainbow tie-dye with a backpack, on a scaffold set.
images.style_notes: Everyday teen clothes (green jacket, tie-dye, adidas bag), black scaffolding and blue stage lighting; a theatrical, rock-musical energy.

images.title: Show key art
images.artist: Show logo and key art, Lightning Thief musical team
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical, stage, 2014/2017/2019
images.what_it_shows: Yellow lightning bolt painted through the show title on a deep blue, spray-painted background. Low resolution (251x396).
images.style_notes: Graffiti or spray-stencil lettering, neon yellow on navy; urban, youthful and DIY.

images.title: London 2024, Percy with sword in clouds
images.source_work: The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical, The Other Palace London, 2024
images.what_it_shows: Percy with arms outstretched holding a sword, standing in swirling blue-lit cloud or mist on a dark stage.
images.style_notes: Deep navy with cyan light and stage fog; sword-in-storm silhouette works as a theatrical hero shot.

images.title: DS box art
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, Nintendo DS (Activision), 2010
images.what_it_shows: Nintendo DS box front using the film's Percy with a raised lightning sword over stormy water. Tiny (200x179).
images.style_notes: Reuses film key art; teal and black storm tones. Small file.

images.title: DS screenshot, field battle target select
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, Nintendo DS, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Characters fighting a monster in a grassy field above a target-selection screen.
images.style_notes: Bright green outdoor, small cartoon proportions, stone-textured UI frames.

images.title: DS screenshot, party battle
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, Nintendo DS, 2010
images.what_it_shows: Both DS screens: tiny sprite party fighting in a forest above a three-character party menu with ability icons and portraits.
images.style_notes: Small low-res 3D-ish chibi sprites, dark forest palette; turn-based RPG UI with blue metal frame and trident emblems. Low resolution (256x384).

images.title: DS screenshot, trident special attack
images.source_work: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief, Nintendo DS, 2010
images.what_it_shows: A glowing blue trident effect over the party in battle, with the party status menu below.
